$comment: Registry of Machine-registered products. This file is the source of truth
for WHICH projects this storefront is allowed to represent. It is written by
`resale` is the field that stops a real project being published as a
sellable product without a decision. BLG-GEL-001 is finished but its own
README says it was built for one specific blog and is not for resale, so it
is recorded as not-for-resale. The gate refuses to publish anything whose
`status` is the storefront's own lifecycle, not the template project's:
draft      - registered, deliberately not published, needs pricing + owner sign-off
published  - live in the storefront catalog and in sitemap.xml
withdrawn  - was published, must not be any more

products.notes: Real, finished, the most advanced project in the workspace. NOT listed for sale: its README states it was built for one specific blog and is not for distribution. AdSense slots exist but no AdSense code is integrated, so adsenseOptimized is false rather than assumed. No hosted docs site and no packaged trial build exist yet.
